metadata.title: Show a solution, ban it, see what replaces it (exposure-ban experiment, Qwen3-8B bf16) - demo subset

source.selection: all 66 events (33 banned algorithms Y x NAMED / UNNAMED): the frozen C1 analysis (advance rule, paired Wilcoxon tests, placebos) is defined over the whole event set

added_fields.metadata_survivors: catalogue modes of the task minus Y (results/c1_events.jsonl)
added_fields.metadata_veto_rounds: iterated signature veto under the COPY prompt: vetoed n-grams (decoded) and re-emergence of Y per round (predictions/veto_rounds.json)

display_names.hash_set: a hash set of seen values
display_names.value_binary_search: binary search on the value range
display_names.index_marking: index marking in the input array

display_names.hash_map: a hash map of seen values

display_names.dag_longest_path: a longest path in the interval graph

display_names.fenwick: a Fenwick tree over compressed values

reference_results._note: Numbers reported by the original full run (results/c1_summary.json, results/rederive.json, results/other_reports.json).  The event-level ones are recomputed by the notebook; the sample-level ones need the 10,600 generated programs and are shown for context only.
